def smallest_odd_prime_divisor_of_S_fast(c, start=3, limit=10000000):
    fact2025 = math.factorial(2025)  # compute once
    for p in primerange(start, limit+1):
        if p == 2:

        mod = p-1
        k_mod = fact2025 % mod
        M_mod = pow(3, k_mod, p)
        if (M_mod - 1 + c) % p == 0:
            return p
    return None
